translation:
Koizumi is very good at getting information
out of people, isn't he?

Absolutely. Koizumi is a master of the art of
conversation.

Conversations… They're a bit difficult for me.
It'd be nice if I could get better at them.

I don't think you really need conversational
skills, Mikuru!

Instead of using words, if you just smile at
someone that's good enough.

You'll one-shot any guy with it, and it'll be
popular with girls, too.

So basically, you don't really need to be that
skilled at communication.

Ah, but then Koizumi not only has his speech,
but that easy smile as well. A double attack!

So if you could just become good at
conversing too, you'd have nothing to fear!
